products.name: Water Reading Exception Desk
products.product: A focused pool service water chemistry exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pool maintenance and repair companies running recurring routes
products.problem: Out-of-range readings, unusual chemical demand, equipment observations, and unsafe service conditions are logged at the stop but follow-up ownership and customer communication can remain unclear.
products.valueProposition: Turns pool service water chemistry exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every material pool-reading exception has verified input, approved response, owner, customer notice, and a scheduled recheck.
products.topic: pool service water chemistry exception tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pool chemical reading tracker, pool water test software, pool chemistry service report, and pool route exception searches.
